mapper.select: SELECT r.*, COUNT(ri.id) AS pad_count FROM pad_mold_reserve_record r LEFT JOIN pad_mold_reserve_item ri ON ri.reserve_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{id} GROUP BY r.id
mapper.update: UPDATE pad_mold_reserve_record SET status = 'EXPIRED', release_time = end_time, release_conclusion = '到期自动释放，垫板恢复可领', release_operator = '系统', update_time = #{now} WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE') AND end_time < #{now}
